note: Round-68 OpenSSF Scorecard API machine contract. S102 is the swagger 2.0 document served by api.securityscorecards.dev/swagger.json (info.version 1.1.0, host api.scorecard.dev): the route family, the ScorecardResult/ScorecardCheck/Repo/Error definitions and the aggregate-score field. It is the machine interface to the scorecard data, NOT the check documentation the lane already holds (F35/S086) and not any served instance. A second candidate, one live project result at /projects/github.com/ossf/scorecard, was opened this round and refused as an entry source: the served JSON is one 13259-byte line, so it carries no located line anchors and its values (date, aggregate score, per-check scores) are instance data that change with every analysis. Both URLs were fetched 2026-11-04T21:49:46Z with the lane instrument; only S102 is recorded here.
